subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After the redirects are restored and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103604 lands, should the exact final head be authorized to remove the temporary qa-matrix workspace package and lockfile importer?
rationale: The dependency guard requires a repository admin or secops member to accept the exact-head package graph removal, and the stacked base must be coordinated before merge.

options.title: Land stack then authorize
options.body: Restore both redirects, land the preceding PR, refresh the head if needed, and authorize the exact dependency-removal SHA.

options.title: Retain compatibility package
options.body: Keep the temporary qa-matrix package and importer until maintainers choose a later cleanup window.

options.title: Pause the cleanup
options.body: Leave this final stack step open if the package removal is not worth the documentation and dependency coordination now.

recommendation.title: Land stack then authorize
recommendation.body: Restore both redirects, land the preceding PR, refresh the head if needed, and authorize the exact dependency-removal SHA.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the complete Matrix QA consolidation stack and can coordinate final exact-head review with an authorized repository approver.
